title: On Closing the shop an hour early
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：close　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 close 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the researcher ① closed the shop an hour early in silence, and every student in the lab said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the researcher ② closes the shop an hour early twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ close the shop an hour early at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ closed the shop an hour early before — a line in the paper for February 1966 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Closing the shop an hour early in silence, the researcher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ close the meeting with a short prayer twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Close the meeting with a short prayer at once and never mention it again.

By 1979 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the paper, and a new student from the next lab ⑧ closes the meeting with a short prayer in silence every term without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ closed the shop an hour early again when nobody else would.

⑩ To close the shop an hour early, my mother said in 1984, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the lab remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the lab forgets, somebody closes the shop an hour early twice over again and somebody must close the shop an hour early in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 关闭（一般过去式 closed the shop an hour early：1972 年研究员头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 关闭（一般现在 closes the shop an hour early：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 关闭（不定式 to close the shop an hour early：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 关闭（过去完成时 had closed the shop an hour early：1966 年二月的研究报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 关闭（动名词 closing the shop an hour early 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 结束（close the meeting with a short prayer：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去结束用一段简短祷告收场）
G. v. 结束（close the meeting with a short prayer：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 关闭（后段两处：新来的学生照例 closes the meeting with a short prayer，而母亲又一次 closed the shop an hour early）

answers.why: close 意为“关闭”，1972 年研究员一言不发地关闭提前一个钟头关铺子，那是实验室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 closed。
close 意为“关闭”，自那以后研究员来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 closes。
close 意为“关闭”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯关闭提前一个钟头关铺子”，此处为不定式 to close the shop an hour early。
close 意为“关闭”，研究报告里 二月 那行字说明早在 1979 年之前就有人关闭过，故用过去完成时 had closed。
close 意为“关闭”，研究员说“关闭提前一个钟头关铺子这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 closing the shop an hour early 作主语。
close 意为“结束”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去结束用一段简短祷告收场”，should ever 之后用原形 close the meeting with a short prayer。
close 意为“结束”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻结束用一段简短祷告收场（close the meeting with a short prayer at once），以后再也不要提起。
close 意为“关闭”，新来的学生每个学期都照例结束用一段简短祷告收场，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 closes。
close 意为“关闭”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地关闭提前一个钟头关铺子，用一般过去式 closed 叙述。
close 意为“关闭”，结尾那句是母亲 1984 年的话：要关闭提前一个钟头关铺子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和实验室记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 close 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1972 the researcher closed the shop an hour early in silence, and nobody in the lab forgot it.
Even now the researcher closes the shop an hour early twice over whenever the lab asks.
Closing the shop an hour early in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever close the meeting with a short prayer twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new student from the next lab closes the meeting with a short prayer in silence every term, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother closed the shop an hour early again, and the lab remembered that half.
